title: Shaam Hogayi Mere Asghar Nu Koi Mor Leyaway
body:
Khaimay De Dar Tay Akay Ujri Rubab Ro Ro Haye Vain Ye Paaway
<<DIVIDER>>
Dashte Veeran Ch Chaah Gaya Pur Khauf Hanera
Mata Kaleya Dar Na Jaaway Cheh Maah Da Laal Mera
Bin Maa De Ronda Hosi Mitiyan Tay Hait Us Nu Haye Neend Na Aaway
<<DIVIDER>>
Ujre Na Koi Jholi Kisay Maa Di Waang Mere
Abad Laal Shala Akhiyan De Rehn Nere
Duniya Tay Haye Kadi Wi Putran Di Maut Da Gham Qismat Na Vikhaway
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar De Cholay Chum Ke Ro Akhdi Sakina
Kenu Loriyan Sunawan Nahi Chain Zindagi Da
Duniya Ton Tur Gaya Ai Teri Behn Veer Da Hun Kenu Ja Kay Khilaway
<<DIVIDER>>
Naizay De Naal Baramabad Teri Lash Kerdi Lokaan
Is Gal Nu Soch Ke Main Hanjuan Nu Keewain Rokaan
Hurn Bachra Tera Baba Karbal Di Kehri Jaa Tay Teri Qabar Banaway
